question.text: For open-ended Category III AIFs, NAV disclosure to investors must be at LEAST:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 265, NAV calculated on each Valuation Day shall be disclosed quarterly for closed-ended AIFs and monthly for open-ended AIFs; open-ended Category III AIFs calculate NAV at least once in a calendar month. The Trap: Daily is more frequent than the source-mandated minimum; quarterly applies to closed-ended AIFs; annually is non-compliant. Note: Hold to the workbook rule of at-least-monthly disclosure for open-ended Category III AIFs.
